item.title: Southern Manitoba Expecting Blast of Winter: 15 to 25 cm of Snow Possible
item.description: WINNIPEG -- A blast of winter weather will make its way into southern Manitoba tonight, bringing with it the potential of 15 to 25 cm of snow.

item.title: Arrest Made in Fatal Crash That Killed Royal Canoe Bassist
item.description: A man wanted in connection with a fatal vehicle crash that killed Royal Canoe bassist Brendan Berg and his partner last summer has been arrested.

item.title: Jury Hears Accused Mass Killer Shot Up Winnipeg Suite After Days on Crack, Alcohol
item.description: A man accused of fatally shooting five people in a Winnipeg rooming house opened fire after days of using drugs and drinking alcohol there, a Crown prosecutor said on the first day of trial.

item.title: Manitoba Delegation in Mexico to Pursue New Trade Opportunities
item.description: A Manitoba delegation is in Mexico this week as part of a federal trade mission aimed at expanding market access and strengthening international partnerships.

item.title: Former Winnipeg Bureaucrat Grilled Over Meetings, Emails with Contract Bidder
item.description: A former chief administrative officer with the City of Winnipeg testified Tuesday it wasn't right of him to meet with a contractor bidding on a major project.

item.title: Teen Charged in Young Street Homicide: Police
item.description: WINNIPEG -- A 14-year-old boy has been charged in connection with a homicide at a home in the 500 block of Young Street last weekend.

item.title: Manitoba Company Fined After Worker Killed in Machine Incident
item.description: A Manitoba company has been fined after a fatal workplace incident at Wintec Building Services Inc. in 2022.

item.title: Winnipeg Comedy Festival Announces 2026 Gala Hosts
item.description: The Winnipeg Comedy Festival is celebrating its 25th anniversary this spring with a weeklong lineup of shows featuring established stars and emerging Canadian comedians.

item.title: Pedestrian Killed in Crash Near Brady Road Landfill
item.description: A 43-year-old man has died after being struck by a vehicle in Winnipeg’s southwest end early last Friday.

item.title: Former Winnipeg Bureaucrat Questioned at Inquiry on Money from Contractor
item.description: A former chief administrative officer with the City of Winnipeg faced more questions Wednesday about money he received from a contractor who was doing business with the city on a major capital project.
